en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade from eating what the ant carried with its mouth and its legs’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah prohibited eating of what ants carry in their mouth or with their legs.”
